text_block_list.text:
Whether or not to aim for conquering three 
divisions— we haven't reached a conclusion 
yet, but our immediate goal, the Hanshin 
Cup, remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"What should we do for the next menu? I 
already cleared yesterday's tasks, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! Gran, would you like to train with 
me today?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Taiki-senpai! Are you asking me to 
train together?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Autumn is here, after all. I want 
to see how much you've grown, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But, today is roadwork! How about a light 
mountain climb?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, 3 miles sounds like fun! What do you 
think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, sure. Take care on your way.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This mountain is where the "Shundai 
Festival" takes place, right!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A festival of the Umamusume, by the 
Umamusume, for the Umamusume: the 'Shundai 
Festival'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is the venue where the 'Sacred 
Horse Dash' of the Shundai Festival took 
place!

The 'Shinme Kakeru' is held once every few 
years at the 'Shundai Festival'. The 
'Shinme' runs up this mountain and 
performs several rituals at the 'Kakeba' 
above.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The mountain slopes are very steep, YES. 
Grand, let's do our best, SHOW!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... This feels so good! The 
autumn leaves are so pretty, too♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Alright, ramping up power to 31 miles!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Great! Nice speed!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, that's fifty miles of pure 
refreshment!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gran, dat was a wonderful run, YES! You 
have become much more powerful than 
before!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
! Come to think of it... even though it 
was a steep slope, my legs carried me up 
with ease.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Both my power and stamina have grown very, 
very much!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories seems 
totally within reach, yes!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But, a match is a fickle thing; it is 
not an absolute certainty.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I think your abilities are more than 
sufficient!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...If I do that, will it put you at ease, 
Trainer...?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What? What are you worried about, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I understand your concern, Trainer. There 
is definitely a risk, after all...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You always put me first. Not just for 
right now, but thinking about my future 
too...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Still! Conquering all three divisions is 
something I can't give up! Because that's 
my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I want to aim for it together with 
you...! I just... don't know what I should 
do...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Will you listen to the story of me and the 
Triple Crown triumph?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—It was after I won a Sprint GⅠ and a Mile 
GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What we chose next was... an overseas 
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even for me, undefeated in domestic mile 
races, winning overseas was so difficult.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But, I won a GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Different turf, different strategies, all 
in France! It was a very, very hard race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I close my eyes, I can still remember 
it... That excitement back then, the 
cheers from everyone...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was fulfilled, basking in victory.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's just, looking back on it later... I 
really wanted to try challenging the 
Three-Division Championship—yes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I do not regret choosing to go overseas.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But, winning three different divisions... 
It has always been stuck in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...If you lose, you could give up. If you 
can't take the challenge, the "what if" 
will linger forever.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, I have a reason for coming to 
this place today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gran, do you know what is written on the 
horseshoe plate of the "Shinbaku"?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The feelings of retired Umamusume... was 
that it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! I got to see it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...The feelings written on the 'horseshoe 
plaque' were... undying feelings for a 
dream that was never reached, yes."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I might write on it too... An 
indelible 'what if'... onto the Horseshoe 
Plaque.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ………… That might be true. But—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Strong feelings... might just reach them. 
Because feelings have power."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Vill I be able to see it? Ze scenery I 
so vish to see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I hope so too. May you also see the view 
you desire."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, I wanted to run with the grown-up Gran 
and see for myself, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If Gran can show me the scenery I've 
always wanted to see— I won't need these 
"pads" anymore!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If I achieve it... you will?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If you, a fellow miler, can achieve 
itâ then my "what-if" will disappear.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Gran. Please don't have any regrets, 
you hear?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories is 
difficult, yes. You should make the 
challenge when you are at your peak, yes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Please do not miss your chance, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Timing her peak form...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "...Taiki-senpai! I... I—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking on the challenge: conquering 
all three divisions!! I won't leave any 
room for regrets!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I have to convince 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I wish you ze best of luck!

Gran Alegria returned, having finished her 
roadwork.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going out to find a new rule 
of thumb, so please come along with me!
choice_data_list:
...Eh? L-Looking for your own personal 
rule?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wonder where would be good... For 
now, let's think about it while we walk!

And the place we arrived at was... Tokyo 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Racecourses on weekdays are so quiet, 
aren't they? So vast and quiet... it gives 
me one mile of goosebumps.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I really do love a lively racetrack, 
after all!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Trainer, do you feel 
more relaxed when it's quiet, or lively?
choice_data_list: I'd say it's on the quiet side.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, well then, shall we try meditating or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Puhaah! I started overthinking things, so 
it didn't work!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No making up your own rules for 
meditation!

The facilities open on weekdays are 
limited. Next, we visited the Umamusume 
Museum.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Looking at photos of them running brings 
back the excitement of the race, doesn't 
it?
choice_data_list:
I know. I can picture the cheers and your 
footsteps.

I understand. I can picture the cheers and 
the sound of your footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right?! ...Ah, the cheering might actually 
work!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Picturing the packed stands and the 
deafening roar of the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yup, excitement level at 30 miles! My legs 
are just itching to run!
choice_data_list:
Time for my personal skip rule to come 
into play!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I wasn't supposed to get excited!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's not easy finding one, a new rule of 
my own...

I tagged along without really 
understanding what was happening, but it 
seems she hasn't found her new personal 
rule yet.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer-san, how do you usually 
watch my races?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Like after entering the gates, while 
waiting for the start.

The moments after gate loading— are when 
my tension as a spectator reaches its 
absolute peak.

The cheers subsided, and silence fell. 
Every gaze was fixed solely on her at the 
starting gate.
choice_data_list: Holding your breath... are you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Nervous? But Trainer-san, you're not the 
one running, are you?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I might even be more nervous than 
you are.

Yeah. I might be even more nervous than 
you are.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that so! Holding your breath, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Holding your breath makes your whole body 
stiffen up even more, doesn't it? Still, 
it does heighten your concentration...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale...

Gran Alegria closed her mouth, took a deep 
breath, and set off at a leisurely pace.

With her head slightly lowered, she walks 
around for a while.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—This is it! My 100-mile intuition is 
tingling!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My new personal rule: 'Before a big race, 
keep your mouth shut tight and take deep 
breaths while walking'!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now we're all set for the Hanshin 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Look forward to it, Trainer♪
